notes.title: MotoGP™15 – Patch
notes.notes:
[img]http://i59.tinypic.com/2889mdy.png[/img]

Dear Gamers,

we apologize for the issues you were facing in this days, we're happy to inform you that we've yet released a patch to solve them.

[b]You can find below the changelog:[/b]

- Improved stability in many game areas
- Fix for grey windshield in cockpit camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC250GP and Moto 3 - Husqvarna FR250GP
- Fix for grey windshield in 3rd person camera for Moto 3 - KTM RC 250 GP
- Fix for achievement "Milano-Valencia one way!"
- Fix for achievement 'The flying wings!', 'The fastest diapason', 'It was a long time', 'Back from Italy' and 'The Red Baron', now unlocked in any game mode
- AI riders visible on track when racing in qualifying sessions
- Fix for rain particles effect
- Fix for rain effect when light rain weather is selected
- Fix for dirt and scratches effects on riders
- Fixed bike names on leaderboards
- Various minor fixes

Please help us to improve your game experience by reporting issues on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/355130/discussions/0/530645446306410539/ ]Bug Thread[/url]

Continue to follow us on: 

- [url=http://www.facebook.com/motogpvideogame] Facebook [/url] 
- [url=http://www.youtube.com/motogpvideogame] Official Youtube Channel [/url]
- [url=https://twitter.com/milestoneitaly] Twitter [/url] [b] hashtag #motogpvideogame [/b]
- [url=http://www.motogpvideogame.com] Official Website [/url]


Milestone Team
